rules: When the requirements basis and prototype goals are ready for focused interactive product exploration with the user.
When a new, incomplete, or stale prototype baseline requires a bounded bootstrap, parity-completion, or refresh task before future-state prototype work.
When the delegated prototype baseline task is complete or blocked and its runnable result and bootstrap evidence are ready for task-result review.
When the interactive prototype, approved UI/UX specification, visual references, requirement-impact finding, not-recommended decision, or blocker is ready for requirements integration.
